description: Severity each earlier hook command classifier gave each command, one letter per classifier in the order of `classifiers`. A false-positive correction keeps the first classifier's rating. A command every classifier rated medium, or every one rated high, keeps that rating unless a medium one is listed as raised on purpose: in `new_detections` when it runs a downloaded or decoded program, or in `fail_closed` when the classifier reads an option or a name it does not resolve as possibly running one.
